text:
The Thessaly Weir diverts the Callan, the Thessaly Water Authority confirmed on 14 March 2019, when the channel's operation was formally approved.

According to the Authority's Callan Basin Flow Assessment, Report No. 7, the weir redirects roughly 38 percent of the river's seasonal flow into the Orrin Canal. The document was released at a public hearing in Port Merrow.

Dr. Imelda Varkonyi, the Authority's Chief Hydrological Engineer, signed off on the channel's operation. Her approval, the report indicates, followed the completion of the flow assessment.

The remaining share of the Callan's seasonal flow continues along its natural course, the assessment states. The Authority's findings are now part of the public record of the hearing, and the report is the principal published account of how the weir apportions the river's water between the Callan and the Orrin Canal.
